social:piasnews-social-f310313c381f15a0:.source_text: Q: was it just the case of not getting things in the right weekend for quali and leaves you on the back foot for today? "Pretty much. I mean, I think it was mostly down to qualifying. I think also lap 1 was far from ideal. Having damage for the whole race. It was tough like that but today I just tried to learn as much as I could to get more out of the car and the way I drive it so hopefully we've learnt a few things for the rest of the year"
social:piasnews-social-f310313c381f15a0:.zh: 问：是不是排位赛没能在合适的周末发挥出来，导致你今天处于被动？"差不多吧。我的意思是，我觉得主要还是排位赛的问题。另外第一圈也远不理想。整场比赛都带着损伤。那样确实很难，但今天我尽量多学习，从赛车和我驾驶它的方式中榨取更多，希望我们为今年剩下的比赛学到了一些东西。"

social:piasnews-social-9e5d0f242259d807:.source_text: Q: Sum up your emotions for us after that one "It was pretty, pretty painful obviously from lap 1 and not much I really could've done from there. the timing of the VSC was certainly not ideal for us, starting on the hard. it was just a difficult afternoon." https://t.co/6zGonKmBQM
social:piasnews-social-9e5d0f242259d807:.zh: 问：跟我们总结一下你在这场比赛后的心情。"显然从第一圈开始就非常非常痛苦，从那时起我几乎无能为力。VSC的时机对我们来说肯定不理想，毕竟我们是用硬胎起步的。那只是一个艰难的下午。"
